summary: In a group where Nora has learned to do something differently, what she learned now goes ahead of her general guidance; her hard rules still always win.
details: Her lessons for a group used to rank below all of her standing instructions, so a lesson could never change a default she was given.
Now a lesson goes ahead of how she behaves, talks and fits in by default; her rules and who she is still win over any lesson.
limitations: Lessons are still few (four so far), so most groups see no difference yet.
A wrong lesson can now override a default; lessons are checked against her rules when written, not against the defaults.
